actual_whitespace_check: All source text operators were decoded through actual PDF font maps: zero actual glyphs become whitespace. Extracted layout spaces/newlines are preserved. The portable checker repeats this inspection.
calligraphic_letters: CMSY B,D,K,P,L are visibly calligraphic. Their script Unicode identities are recorded; NFC preserves and NFKC folds compatibility forms. Raw counts are also retained. Ordinary math italic/roman letters are already their base Unicode letters, not erroneous aliases.
composite_symbols: Actual square brackets are [ or ]; brace top/middle/bottom/extender pieces and diagonal edge pieces remain separate. No reconstruction of positioning or graph incidence.
literal_errors_preserved: The question marks in L074 page 9 are literal printed question marks in CMR10; they are not changed to rho. Accent spacing, printed hyphens and all extraction order are unchanged.

correction.reason: One L066 ToUnicode codepoint has several original encoded glyph identities; the old metadata loop overwrote earlier bytes, causing square brackets to be miscalibrated as brace pieces.
